remarks:
From the moment you step through the front door, you'll appreciate how comfortable and inviting this home feels. Filled with natural light and beautiful views, it offers plenty of space to gather, entertain, or simply enjoy everyday living.

The welcoming foyer leads to the formal living and dining rooms, where hardwood floors add warmth. French doors open to the spacious deck with a retractable awning, creating an easy flow between the indoor and outdoor living spaces. Just beyond is the oversized kitchen with an abundance of cupboard and counter space, along with a separate breakfast area.

The main level also offers two bedrooms, including one with French doors leading directly to the deck, along with a full bath. Upstairs you'll find three additional bedrooms, each with views of Chautauqua Lake, and a second full bath, providing plenty of space for family and guests.

The full walk-out basement is an incredible extension of the home, featuring a huge family room with a gas fireplace, wet bar, and sliding glass doors leading to the patio and hot tub. Whether you're entertaining a crowd or enjoying a quiet evening at home, this is a space you'll find yourself using year-round. A large utility room and separate storage room provide plenty of space to keep everything organized.

An attached two-car garage, forced-air heat, central air, a backup generator, and a whole-house surge protector add to the home's comfort and convenience. Outside, the thoughtfully landscaped yard features a partially fenced area, storage shed, and beautiful outdoor spaces to enjoy throughout the seasons.
